signatureBoundary: Bundled SHA-256 integrity is accepted. A remote signature is intentionally PENDING; no unverified remote manifest may be consumed or used to alter an endpoint.
compatibility: Financial products can safely consume this bounded contract for standard Wallet connection and real degradation classifications. They cannot call PENDING or UNAVAILABLE product endpoints.
migration: remove hard-coded endpoint values and import the bundled manifest through the accepted DApp Connect SDK; retain normal Wallet operation when Product Session endpoints degrade.
rollback: revert this acceptance and preserve prior endpoint behavior until another exact, integrity-pinned manifest is accepted.
publicClaim: none; endpoint acceptance is not installed-client or public-deployment proof.
